transcript.text: Thank you all for being here. I want to start by sharing my report and request. Over the course of this project, I experienced three specific incidents where Darius interrupted me during meetings and decisions connected to my work were made without including me. These incidents affected my ability to contribute effectively to the project. My request is for clear interim working safeguards that ensure I'm included in decisions related to my work area and that meeting norms prevent repeated interruptions so we can continue collaborating productively. I have documentation of these incidents that I can share if it would be helpful for the review.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: Thank you, Leah. I appreciate you laying out your concerns clearly. I want to give my report as well. I do not deny that these incidents occurred — I was present for them. While I did not intend to exclude you, I recognize the impact on you and your work, and I take that seriously. I am willing to participate in a facilitated resolution process. I want to be able to offer a direct apology to Leah without turning this into a debate about my intent versus the outcomes. Before any facilitated session, I would request a separate preparation meeting to ensure the process itself is set up well, and I'd ask that the facilitator be genuinely neutral — someone with no prior involvement in this situation. I want to emphasize that I'm not here to minimize what Leah experienced. I'm here to find a workable path forward that respects her contributions and allows us to collaborate effectively.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you both. I'll give my report now. As Line Manager, I can confirm that Leah raised these concerns with me directly, and I took them seriously enough to escalate for this review. I've been monitoring the team's working dynamics since the concerns were raised, and the team has continued to function, though I recognize that functioning and working well are not the same thing. My request is that whatever interim safeguards Simone puts in place are practical and clearly time-bound, so that everyone understands what to expect and we can rebuild trust without ambiguity. I want to add that I'm committed to supporting both Leah and Darius through whatever process Simone decides on, and I'll do my part to make sure any safeguards are implemented smoothly on my end.

transcript.text: Thank you, Leah, Darius, and Elena, for your reports. I'll give my report now. As Employee Relations Specialist, I've reviewed the record on this case. Under the applicable resolution procedure, the appropriate path forward involves a neutral facilitator, a written no-retaliation notice, and a formal follow-up check-in exactly 14 days after the resolution meeting. I want to flag that I have not yet added this procedural guidance to Simone's case notes, and I want to make sure she has it before finalizing the outcome. My request is that Simone consider this resolution path — which aligns with what both Leah and Darius have already indicated they're open to — and that the interim safeguards Elena referenced be tied to this facilitated process with the 14-day follow-up built in.
